quote: 1. The business schools reward difficult, complex behavior more than simple behavior, but simple behavior is more effective.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 2. In the long run, it's difficult for a stock to earn a much better return than the business which underlies it earns.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 3. Buy stocks, take sleeping pills, and look at them again after many years. Then you will see: you are rich.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 4. It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 5. The stock market is 90 percent psychology and 10 percent reality.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 6. The world is full of foolish gamblers, and they will not do as well as the patient investor.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 7. The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 8. It is remarkable how much long-term advantage people like us have gotten by trying to be consistently not stupid, instead of trying to be very intelligent.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 9. Rule number one: most things will prove to be cyclical. Rule number two: some of the greatest opportunities for gain and loss come when other people forget rule number one.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 10. Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget rule No. 1.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 11. It's not greed that drives the world, but envy.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 12. Success carries within itself the seeds of failure, and failure the seeds of success.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 13. It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 14. I constantly see people rise in life who are not the smartest, sometimes not even the most diligent, but they are learning machines.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 15. Success in investing doesn't come from buying good things, but from buying things well.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 16. In the business world, the rearview mirror is always clearer than the windshield.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 17. A great business at a fair price is superior to a fair business at a great price.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 18. Buy when the cannons thunder, sell when the violins play.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 19. Games are won by players who focus on the playing field — not by those whose eyes are glued to the scoreboard.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 20. Knowing what you don't know is more useful than being brilliant.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 21. Markets are always biased in one direction or another.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 22. Only when the tide goes out do you discover who's been swimming naked.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 23. A majority of life's errors are caused by emotion getting in the way of clear thinking.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 24. You can't eat relative performance.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 25. Never invest in a business you cannot understand.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 26. A lot of people with high IQs are terrible investors because they've got terrible temperaments.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 27. The riskiest thing in the world is the belief that there is no risk.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 28. Time is the friend of the wonderful business, the enemy of the mediocre.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 29. It's not given to human beings to have such talent that they can just know everything about everything all the time.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 30. There are old investors, and there are bold investors, but there are no old bold investors.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 31. I try to buy stock in businesses that are so wonderful that an idiot can run them. Because sooner or later, one will.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 32. Show me the incentive and I will show you the outcome.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 33. If I have an advantage over others, it's that I'm more aware of my fallibility.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 34. I never attempt to make money on the stock market. I buy on the assumption that they could close the market the next day and not reopen it for five years.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 35. Stock market bubbles don't grow out of thin air. They have a solid basis in reality, but reality as distorted by a misconception.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 36. I'm a great believer in solving hard problems by using lattice-works of mental models.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 37. Wide diversification is only required when investors do not understand what they are doing.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 38. Acknowledging what you don't know is the dawning of wisdom.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 39. It's not what you buy; it's what you pay.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 40. The most important thing to do if you find yourself in a hole is to stop digging.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 41. The best thing a human being can do is to help another human being know more.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 42. Once we realize that imperfect understanding is the human condition, there is no shame in being wrong, only in failing to correct our mistakes.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 43. The investor of today does not profit from yesterday's growth.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 44. To speculate, you need money, ideas, patience, and luck.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 45. Financial markets are inherently unstable.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 46. If you aren't willing to own a stock for ten years, don't even think about owning it for ten minutes.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 47. When I see a bubble forming, I rush in to buy, adding fuel to the fire.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 48. The economy is the master and the stock market is the dog on the leash.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 49. The stock market is designed to transfer money from the active to the patient.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 50. Never, ever, think about something else when you should be thinking about the power of incentives.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 51. Whoever wants to sleep well should sell shares down to the sleeping level.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 52. Someone is sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 53. Smart people go broke three ways: liquor, ladies and leverage.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 54. If everyone believes something is risky, their unwillingness to buy usually reduces its price to the point where it isn't risky at all.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 55. Price is what you pay; value is what you get.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 56. Invert, always invert.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 57. Being too far ahead of your time is indistinguishable from being wrong.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 58. Only buy something that you'd be perfectly happy to hold if the market shut down for 10 years.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 59. The first rule of compounding: Never interrupt it unnecessarily.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 60. We may never know where we're going, but we'd better have a good idea where we are.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 61. The stock market is a no-called-strike game. You don't have to swing at everything — you can wait for your pitch.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 62. Take a simple idea and take it seriously.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 63. Experience is what you got when you didn't get what you wanted.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 64. I don't look to jump over seven-foot bars: I look around for one-foot bars that I can step over.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 65. I never allow myself to have an opinion on anything that I don't know the other side's argument better than they do.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 66. You can't predict. You can prepare.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 67. Chains of habit are too light to be felt until they are too heavy to be broken.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 68. The best way to get what you want is to deserve what you want.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 69. The financial markets generally are unpredictable. So that one has to have different scenarios.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 70. Our favorite holding period is forever.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 71. If you're not willing to react with equanimity to a market price decline of 50% two or three times a century, you're not fit to be a common shareholder, and you deserve the mediocre result you're going to get.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 72. Good investing is a peculiar balance between humility and arrogance.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 73. Predicting rain doesn't count; building arks does.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 74. The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 75. It's not whether you're right or wrong, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 76. Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 77. The first rule of a happy life is low expectations.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 78. Those who have money can speculate; those who have none must not.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 79. You only have to do a very few things right in your life so long as you don't do too many things wrong.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 80. The desire to get rich fast is pretty dangerous.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 81. Markets are constantly in a state of uncertainty and flux and money is made by discounting the obvious and betting on the unexpected.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 82. Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 83. If investing is entertaining, if you're having fun, you're probably not making any money. Good investing is boring.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 84. Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 85. The best investment you can make is an investment in yourself.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 86. It is waiting that helps you as an investor, and a lot of people just can't stand to wait.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 87. The worse a situation becomes, the less it takes to turn it around, and the bigger the upside.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 88. Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 89. People calculate too much and think too little.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 90. The less prudence with which others conduct their affairs, the greater the prudence with which we must conduct our own.
speaker: Howard Marks
